methodology: 30 fresh process/setup runs per scheme; one untimed warmup per process; 3334 deterministic public target indices per run, 100020 measured queries per scheme; real pinned SimplePIR LWE preprocessing and full 64-bit output oracle checks. Cryptographic randomness is freshly OS-seeded in each process; workload seed is public only. Frozen copied executables hashed before/after. In-process single-thread timings exclude network/authentication/compilation. Shared host; query outcomes share setup and are not independent setup trials.
